Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
I was thinking recently about a nasty combo. Get Inner Circle Member
out and put a Soul Gem and a skill card on him. The next thing you do
is Mind Rape some younger vampire. On your next turn you play a
Minion Tap on Etrius and s Fortitude skill card on the MInd Raped
vampire then use the Heidleburg Castle to transfer the Soul Gem to the
Mind Raped vampire and transfer all the blood from that vampire to
Etrius. The Mind Raped vampire must hunt. You then play Force of
Will on the Mind Raped Vampire. This burns the Mind Raped Vampire.
Which crypt does the Soul Gem activate the vampire from?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr.
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Assuming his hunt didn't get blocked (typically resulting in his

Yours. "You" on card text always refers to the controller of the card.

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:

> Minion Tap on Etrius and s Fortitude skill card on the MInd Raped
> vampire then use the Heidleburg Castle to transfer the Soul Gem to the
> Mind Raped vampire and transfer all the blood from that vampire to
> Etrius. The Mind Raped vampire must hunt. You then play Force of
> Will on the Mind Raped Vampire. This burns the Mind Raped Vampire.
> Which crypt does the Soul Gem activate the vampire from?
>

How about minion tap the stolen vampire (or choose one with 1 blood),
and have him take the Soul Gem form Etrius, using Daring the Dawn?

I'm curious as to why you need Etrius to make it work though. Just
because he'll be bigger than anything he's trying to take? The
problem with the Mind Rape/Soul Gem combo is that in order to get Mind
Rape off, you need a vampire that is bigger than the vampire you're
trying to take. In order for the Soul Gem to help you out, you have
to have a vampire on the top of your crypt that is smaller than the
vampire you stole. I assume you can see the problem here.

That said, it's still a nasty combo when you get it off, but you can't
really count on it without a bit more trickery than that...

If you're going to bother using Recruitment, why bother with Grendel?
Just play with a weenie crypt, and Recruit the one big guy.

If I were making the deck, I'd probably go with a full weenie crypt,
half Settites, half Tremere. I'd use Temptation instead of Mind Rape,
and use Seeds of Corruption to empty the vamps, with a few Cryptic
Missions for strategic placement. Throw in a whole bunch of Fortitude
Skill cards, and a few Thaum and Ser skill cards (dual use... for your
own vamps *and* to beef up your prey's weenies), some Soul Gems and
some Daring the Dawns. You could possibly play it with no combat, no
bleed, no vote, and no defense. I don't know if it'd be possible to
actually make it a good deck, but it could be fun to try.
Unfortunately, it's probably still a little slower than straight out
corruption.

Free States Rant wouldn't hurt either, although you couldn't really
call it for more than 2... still would be at least as good as the
Cryptics.

Hell, I might actually make this monstrosity some time soon. Would be
scary if 3 or 4 or 5 Temptations were all ready at the same time and
you could just chain the Soul Gem from vamp to vamp, Daring the Dawn
everytime. Mwahahahaha.
